constraints: Do not change world height bounds without a dedicated compatibility test.
Do not continuously rewrite terrain with Script API.
Treat this numeric sampler as a design prototype, not a replacement for Bedrock's base terrain generator.
Use official biome and feature generation systems where supported; validate each schema against the target Bedrock build.
Terrain fields are smooth deterministic design signals only; they do not alter Minecraft chunks.
River and valley masks are prototype signals and do not create water blocks or carve channels.
